Use case: precise-object-edit
Input1 is the edit target: blank hand-painted very dark blue-violet circular ornament texture. Input2 is the exact native source/layout/palette reference. Input3 is ONLY a brightness-boosted copy of the native source to make its actual low-contrast grooves easier to trace; DO NOT copy its brighter palette.

The source has curving concentric/spiral stepped bands, asymmetrical radial bands, shorter horizontal extensions from the LEFT toward the center, and hooked/curved descending segments around the right/lower part. Preserve original dark gaps, connections and broad shading. Do not replace it with symmetrical spoke sectors or a new centered wheel/ring/clock face. Carefully follow every native major band and opening in the boosted guide; modernize only subtle edge bevel and material microtexture. Keep low native blue/purple-grey brightness and understated relief; this is dark environmental architecture, not emissive.
Keep canvas64:61 aspect, original circular outer silhouette/perimeter, top horizontal grey-blue strip, surrounding black/navy padding and tiny neighboring fragments exactly as the edit target. No new central disk, teeth, screws, flowers, skulls, symbols, runes, writing, extra structural grooves or lights. Flat texture crop, no perspective/margins, full opaque canvas, no text or watermark.
